correctness.rationale: The closed neighborhoods are exactly F_i={a_i}∪(B\{b_i}) and E_i={b_i}∪(A\{a_i}). Their union is X; U generated by F_i collapses cone-by-cone relative to B to ∂Δ(B)≈S^{n−2}, and V symmetrically to ∂Δ(A). The intersection U∩V has only the cross edges a_i b_j (i≠j), i.e. the connected crown graph, with first Betti count n(n−1)−2n+1=n²−3n+1. For n≥5 the two sphere targets are simply connected, making both maps from the 1-dimensional connected intersection nullhomotopic. The cofibration homotopy pushout splits as U∨V∨Σ(U∩V), giving precisely two S^{n−2} and n²−3n+1 S² integrally. Fresh direct binary face homology at n=5 yielded {2:11,3:2}, corroborating; no finite extrapolation is used.
residual_risks: Only n≥5; n=4 boundary has merged sphere dimensions and is previously known as Q3.
